'''Maple Bar''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]]. It may rotate into stock at the [[Traveling Cart]] and is sold for {{Tprice|300}}. It can be purchased from [[Sam]]'s [[Desert Festival#Villager Shops|shop]] at the [[Desert Festival]] for {{Price|20|Calico}} [[Calico Egg]]s. One Maple Bar may be received from opening a [[Mystery Box]].

==Bundles==
Maple Bar is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Tailoring==
Maple Bar is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Dirt Shirt]].  [[File:Shirt275.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

Maple Bar is not used in any [[quests]].
